name: Grok CLI
_comment: Same fallback path as OpenCode: no assumed hook system, so status comes
from tmux pane scraping. Confirm these patterns against the Grok CLI
build you actually run - they are a starting point, not verified.
_bridge_handled: KEY_AGENT1-4: tap = summon that tmux session fullscreen, hold = interrupt it
KEY_TERM: tap = launch launch_command here, double-tap = launch in a split, hold = new window
KEY_MIC: tap = send C-Space (grok's voice toggle; plain Space elsewhere)
KEY_CANCEL: tap = send Escape (deny prompt / interrupt)
KEY_ENTER: approve when a request is pending, hold = sessions overview
_launch_note:
Voice is Ctrl+Space in grok, not Space. Set it with a bindings override in ~/.config/opendeck/config.json:
{"bindings": {"KEY_MIC": {"tap": {"action": "send_keys", "keys": ["C-Space"]}}}}
